facts.fact: Namibia's Procurement Policy Unit says the government has developed an e-GP Portal through which all public entities are required to upload procurement plans, bid adverts, bidding documents, bid opening reports and award notices.
The Procurement Policy Unit says all public entities are required to upload their procurement documents to the e-GP Portal; an end-to-end platform is planned as phase two.

systems.owner: Procurement Policy Unit, Ministry of Finance

NAM.note: Procurement portal only; no citizen or business service stated.
The Act is said to be anchored on the UNCITRAL model law, which is not an information technology or data standard.
Nothing on local government office connection.
Nothing on African digital legal texts.
